details: Delta review confirmed the Z.ai fixture carries user-001 as a plain `content` string with no native block type. Current TranscriptBlock requires a native_type label and u32 block_index, so omitting it loses the user question while inventing input_text would misstate provenance. Awaiting Terra's shared domain contract: optional native_type, optional source_field, and optional block_index. Adapter must then preserve user-001 content as Text with source_field=content and no fabricated native type/index, alongside assistant raw blocks and original indexes.
